**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user was prescribed Tamiflu when they had the flu last time.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is trying to get their health back on track.
- [EVENT] The user is considering getting a flu vaccine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that the flu vaccine is the most effective way to prevent the flu and recommended that everyone 6 months and older gets vaccinated each year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of 10 tips to reduce the risk of getting the flu, including getting vaccinated, washing hands frequently, practicing good hygiene, staying physically active, getting enough sleep, managing stress, eating a balanced diet, staying hydrated, avoiding close contact with sick people, and cleaning and disinfecting surfaces.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant clarified that Tamiflu is an antiviral medication that helps treat and shorten the duration of the flu but is not a preventive measure.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided information on where to get a flu vaccine, including healthcare provider's offices, pharmacies, urgent care centers, community health clinics, health departments, and workplaces.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that the cost of a flu vaccine varies, with the quadrivalent vaccine costing around $20 to $50 and the high-dose vaccine costing around $60 to $70 without insurance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the differences between the quadrivalent and high-dose vaccines, noting that the quadrivalent vaccine protects against four strains of the flu and is recommended for most people, while the high-dose vaccine is designed for seniors and contains four times the antigen.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to consult with their healthcare provider to determine the best flu vaccine for them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for preparing for knee surgery, including following the doctor's instructions and stopping certain medications as advised.
- [TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/05/30 (Tue) at 13:45.
